factory.name: Kaveri Precision Components (demo factory)
factory.note: Synthetic demo data. PlantMind/Ustaad was switched on from 1 Sep 2026.

technicians.name: Arjun Naik
technicians.speciality: Learning — uses Ustaad on every job

logs.symptom: Compressor tripped on high temperature (110°C) in the afternoon, whole plant air down
logs.root_cause: Oil cooler fins choked with dust
logs.action: Cleaned cooler fins with compressed air and water

logs.symptom: Spindle vibrating heavily above 3500 rpm, alarm 2041 (spindle vibration high), surface finish rough
logs.action: Replaced front spindle bearing (7014 angular contact)
logs.notes: Vibration reduced but came back after about 7 weeks

logs.symptom: Boiler tripped on low water level but gauge glass shows normal level
logs.action: Replaced level switch
logs.notes: Tripped again after 4 days.

logs.symptom: ATC arm stuck midway during tool change, alarm 1012 tool change timeout
logs.root_cause: Swarf (chips) on ATC proximity sensor, sensor gap wrong
logs.action: Cleaned swarf off ATC proximity sensor, set sensor gap to 1.5 mm

logs.symptom: Low-water trip again, gauge glass normal
logs.root_cause: Scale on the level probe; softener salt tank empty so hard water reaching boiler
logs.action: Descaled level probe, did blowdown, refilled softener salt and regenerated softener
logs.notes: Check softener salt every Monday.

logs.symptom: High temperature trip again
logs.root_cause: Cooling fan motor capacitor weak, fan slow
logs.action: Replaced fan motor capacitor

logs.symptom: Press ram moving slow, oil temperature 68°C
logs.action: Replaced main cylinder seals
logs.notes: Still slow after seal change.

logs.symptom: Ram still slow after seal change, oil hot
logs.root_cause: Pump suction strainer clogged, oil degraded
logs.action: Cleaned pump suction strainer, changed hydraulic oil (VG 68)
logs.notes: Slow + hot = strainer first. Seals only if oil leaks outside.

logs.symptom: Pallet changer not clamping, alarm 3105 pallet clamp pressure low
logs.root_cause: Rotary joint o-ring leaking, clamp pressure dropping below 40 bar
logs.action: Replaced rotary joint o-ring, set clamp pressure to 45 bar, cleaned pressure switch
logs.notes: Keep spare o-rings.

logs.symptom: High temperature trip, oil looks dark
logs.root_cause: Oil level low and oil separator element choked
logs.action: Topped up oil, replaced separator element
logs.notes: Blow the cooler fins every Friday in summer.

logs.symptom: Alarm 401 servo overload on X-axis, axis moving rough
logs.root_cause: Way-lube oil tank empty, auto-lube pump fuse blown
logs.action: Replaced lube pump fuse, refilled way-lube tank

logs.symptom: Alarm 2051 spindle orientation fault during tool change
logs.action: Re-seated and clamped spindle encoder cable

logs.symptom: Alarm 1012 again, ATC slow and stopping
logs.root_cause: Air pressure at ATC regulator only 5.2 bar (needs 6 bar) plus chips on sensor
logs.action: Set ATC air regulator to 6 bar, cleaned proximity sensor
logs.notes: Low air pressure makes the ATC slow and time out.

logs.symptom: Low-water trip, gauge glass normal
logs.root_cause: Scale on level probe, softener salt empty again
logs.action: Descaled probe, refilled salt
logs.notes: Salt again empty.

logs.symptom: Alarm 2041 again, vibration above 3500 rpm, slight whistling sound at high speed
logs.action: Replaced front spindle bearing again
logs.notes: Vibration back within 19 days. Bearing was not the problem.

logs.symptom: Spindle not starting, main breaker trips at spindle start
logs.root_cause: Supply voltage dipping during spindle start
logs.action: Corrected servo stabilizer settings, checked drive DC bus

logs.symptom: Emergency stop not resetting, press dead
logs.action: Replaced safety relay

logs.symptom: Alarm 2041, whistling sound above 4000 rpm, vibration felt at motor end
logs.root_cause: Motor-to-spindle coupling misaligned by 0.08 mm and coupling spider (rubber element) worn
logs.action: Checked alignment with dial gauge, realigned motor to spindle to under 0.02 mm, replaced coupling spider, torqued coupling bolts to 45 Nm
logs.notes: Whistling sound above 4000 rpm was the clue. No vibration for 80+ days.

logs.symptom: No coolant flow, coolant pump motor smelling burnt
logs.action: Replaced coolant pump motor

logs.symptom: Alarm 401 again on X-axis
logs.root_cause: Way-lube tank empty again — nobody refilling
logs.action: Refilled way-lube tank
logs.notes: Add lube level to shift start checklist.

logs.symptom: Low-water trip on morning start
logs.root_cause: Scale on level probe, salt empty
logs.action: Descaled probe, blowdown, refilled salt
logs.notes: Same root cause — salt refill is being missed.

logs.symptom: Hissing sound, pressure dropping, auto drain stuck open
logs.action: Cleaned auto drain valve

logs.symptom: Alarm 3105, pallet not clamping
logs.action: Replaced pallet clamp pressure switch
logs.notes: Alarm came back after 30 minutes.

logs.symptom: Alarm 3105 continuing after pressure switch change
logs.action: Replaced rotary joint o-ring, reset clamp pressure to 45 bar
logs.notes: Same as June. The new pressure switch was not needed.

logs.symptom: Ram slow, oil warm
logs.action: Tightened hydraulic fittings
logs.notes: No change.

logs.symptom: Ram still slow
logs.root_cause: Suction strainer clogged again — dirt entering through torn rod wiper seal
logs.action: Cleaned suction strainer, replaced rod wiper seal

logs.symptom: First time on CNC-2: ATC stuck, alarm 1012
logs.root_cause: Chips on proximity sensor and air at 5.4 bar
logs.action: Used twin machine CNC-1 history from Ustaad: cleaned sensor, gap 1.5 mm, air regulator to 6 bar
logs.notes: Twin-machine learning: fixed on first try.

logs.symptom: Alarm 2051 again
logs.action: Re-seated encoder connector and added a strain-relief clamp

logs.symptom: Low-water trip, gauge glass normal
logs.action: Ustaad: descaled probe + refilled softener salt (did not change level switch)

logs.symptom: Through-spindle coolant pressure low, tool overheating
logs.root_cause: Coolant filter clogged with fine chips
logs.action: Cleaned coolant filter and flushed the line

logs.symptom: Pressure stuck at 5.5 bar, not loading
logs.action: Replaced inlet valve solenoid coil

logs.symptom: Oil leaking from pressure hose near cylinder
logs.action: Replaced pressure hose

logs.symptom: Mild alarm 2041 at 4200 rpm, small whistling sound
logs.action: Followed Ramesh-ji's July fix from Ustaad: dial gauge check, realigned to 0.015 mm, bolts to 45 Nm
logs.notes: Did NOT touch the bearing. Fixed in 75 minutes using Ustaad.

logs.symptom: Burner lockout, flame failure alarm
logs.action: Cleaned flame photocell

logs.symptom: Alarm 401 on CNC-1 X-axis
logs.action: Checked lube tank first (Ustaad, from twin CNC-2), refilled

logs.symptom: Coolant pump making grinding noise, low flow
logs.action: Cleaned pump impeller and suction strainer

logs.symptom: Low-water trip again
logs.root_cause: Scale on level probe, salt empty
logs.action: Descaled probe, refilled salt
logs.notes: Pattern: every ~40 days.

logs.symptom: Alarm 3105 on night shift, pallet not clamping
logs.action: Ustaad pointed to the o-ring first (not the switch). Replaced o-ring, pressure 45 bar
logs.notes: Fixed in 50 minutes on night shift without calling Ramesh-ji.

logs.symptom: Night shift high temperature trip
logs.action: Cleaned cooler fins (Ustaad: same as May)

logs.symptom: Night shift: ram slow, oil 62°C
logs.action: Ustaad said strainer first: cleaned suction strainer
logs.notes: Did not touch seals.

notes.text: If CNC-3 shows alarm 2041 with a whistling sound above 4000 rpm, it is the motor-spindle coupling, not the bearing. Check alignment with a dial gauge first — it must be under 0.02 mm. Spindle bearings cost ₹38,000; replace them only if the spindle nose temperature crosses 70°C.
Alarm 3105 pallet clamp: 9 out of 10 times it is the small o-ring in the rotary joint (₹350), not the pressure switch. Keep 5 spare o-rings in the maintenance cupboard.
Boiler low-water trip while the gauge glass looks normal means scale on the level probe. The real cause is the softener salt running out. Refill salt every Monday and the trips stop.
Press slow and oil hot: clean the pump suction strainer first. Change seals only if oil is leaking outside the cylinder. Check the rod wiper seal — a torn wiper lets dirt in and chokes the strainer.
From April to June the compressor overheats in the afternoons. Blow the cooler fins every Friday in summer and check the oil level weekly.
ATC alarm 1012 on the VMC-850 machines (CNC-1 and CNC-2): check air pressure at the ATC regulator is 6 bar and clean swarf off the proximity sensor. Sensor gap should be 1.5 mm.
Alarm 401 servo overload on a VMC-850 is almost always an empty way-lube tank. Check the tank at every shift start.
Before calling the machine company's service engineer for any CNC, check the coupling, lubrication and air pressure first — it saves the ₹15,000 visit charge most of the time.
